About Me

Hi! I’m an undergraduate at Georgia Tech studying computer science and mathematics as a Stamps President’s Scholar. I’m interested in building interpretable machine learning systems for biology and clinical AI.

I work on BioML with Professor Pranam Chatterjee at UPenn and Professor Amirali Aghazadeh at Georgia Tech. My current interests include generative modeling, protein design, and evolutionary modeling.

Outside research, I like to read, write, and run!
